Orleans Parish, Louisiana property tax involves the parish assessor's office and the parish sheriff.

Who to contact in Orleans Parish

  • City of New Orleans Bureau of Treasury
  • Orleans Parish Assessor handles assessment and appeals.

What we confirmed on official pages

  • 2026 City bills: payment deadline Feb 28, 2026, after which interest accrues at 1% per month (Orleans differs from Dec 31 used elsewhere in LA) (from the parish site listing; confirm with the office)
  • Payment: mail check/money order/cashier's check (no cash); online at nola.gov, no fee for e-check, 2.49% fee for card, full bill only; temporary drop-off sites and City Hall (1300 Perdido St) curbside drop-off in late Feb 2026 (from the parish site listing; confirm with the office)
  • Treasury does not send delinquent notices and will not waive interest for non-receipt of bill (from the parish site listing; confirm with the office)

We could not confirm a current parish rate on an opened official page. Louisiana bills combine parish, municipal and school district levies.
